Tech Coworking / Innovation Hub
nodes.rationale: CG has 44 tech firms vs 175 benchmark. High-income professionals need shared workspace. Miracle Mile foot traffic ideal.

nodes.name: Managed IT Services Provider
nodes.rationale: 2,730 businesses but minimal local IT support. The Ponce office district is ripe for B2B tech services.

nodes.name: App Development Studio
nodes.rationale: Affluent market, UM talent pipeline, but no local dev shops. Adjacent to Brickell tech corridor.

nodes.name: Cybersecurity Consulting Firm
nodes.rationale: Banking/financial cluster on Alhambra needs specialized security. CG's 52 banks + 61 financial firms are the target market.

nodes.name: Smart Home / IoT Integrator
nodes.rationale: High-income residential + real estate market but zero smart home specialists in CG.

nodes.name: Specialty Coffee Roastery
nodes.rationale: CG's café scene is growing but lacks a locally-roasted brand. Foot traffic + UM students = steady demand.

nodes.name: Farm-to-Table Meal Prep / Ghost Kitchen
nodes.rationale: Health-conscious demographic ($134K median income) but limited healthy prepared food options.

nodes.name: Latin Fusion Bakery
nodes.rationale: CG's Latin heritage + growing foodie scene. South Gables underserved with only 39 F&B businesses.

nodes.name: Craft Cocktail Bar / Speakeasy
nodes.rationale: Giralda is CG's experiential dining district but has only 2 F&B businesses in database.

nodes.name: Organic Grocery / Market
nodes.rationale: 96 businesses near UM but only 14 F&B — students and faculty need grocery/market options.

nodes.name: Boutique Pet Supply Store
nodes.rationale: High-income area with many pet owners but zero pet retail in the database. National trend: pet spending up 12% YoY.

nodes.name: Sustainable / Eco Fashion Boutique
nodes.rationale: Merrick Park is CG's luxury retail zone but only 5 businesses listed. Sustainable luxury trending.

nodes.name: Home Décor / Interior Design Retail
nodes.rationale: $134K median income + active real estate market but limited home retail. Natural complement to 71 RE firms.

nodes.name: Cycling / Outdoor Sports Shop
nodes.rationale: Active outdoor community, popular cycling routes, but no dedicated bike/outdoor shop in CG.

nodes.name: Children's Boutique / Toy Store
nodes.rationale: Family-oriented neighborhood (184 businesses, 31 education) but no children's retail.

nodes.name: Business Formation / Startup Accelerator
nodes.rationale: CG has 129 legal + 112 accounting firms but no formal startup support. UM generates talent.

nodes.name: Immigration Law Boutique
nodes.rationale: CG's international population + proximity to Latin America. Niche underserved despite 129 legal firms.

nodes.name: HR / Payroll Outsourcing Firm
nodes.rationale: 2,730 businesses but very few HR support firms. SMB market is massive.

nodes.name: Executive Coaching & Leadership Dev
nodes.rationale: 474 infrastructure + 674 platform businesses need professional development. Premium market.

nodes.name: Premium Pet Grooming & Daycare
nodes.rationale: Zero pet services in database. Affluent neighborhoods, work-from-office returning — pet daycare demand surging.

nodes.name: Concierge / Errand Service
nodes.rationale: High-income dual-earner households. TaskRabbit-style local concierge model perfect for CG's demo.

nodes.name: Senior Home Care Agency
nodes.rationale: Aging population in South Gables. Healthcare strong (284) but personal care services almost absent.

nodes.name: Mobile Auto Detailing
nodes.rationale: 55 auto dealers + 14 automotive but zero detailing services. High-end vehicle owners = premium demand.

nodes.name: Pilates / Barre Studio
nodes.rationale: CG has 97 wellness businesses but concentrated in general area. Miracle Mile walkability is key.

nodes.name: Mental Health & Therapy Practice
nodes.rationale: Post-pandemic mental health demand. CG's affluent demo can afford premium therapy. Office corridor ideal.

nodes.name: Holistic Wellness Center (Acupuncture/TCM)
nodes.rationale: UM medical campus synergy. Integrative medicine growing 15% annually. Only 6 wellness near UM.

nodes.name: Boutique Event Space / Venue
nodes.rationale: CG's dining/nightlife hub but only 2 businesses listed. Event venues complement F&B cluster.

nodes.name: Eco-Tourism / City Tour Operator
nodes.rationale: CG's Mediterranean architecture, Biltmore Hotel, Venetian Pool = tour potential. Zero tour operators listed.

nodes.name: Property Management Company
nodes.rationale: 71 RE firms but mostly sales. Rental market growing — Coral Gables has 40% renters. Property mgmt demand high.

nodes.name: Commercial Real Estate Advisory
nodes.rationale: CG attracting MNCs (150+). Specialized commercial RE advisory would fill a niche in the office district.

nodes.name: Green Building / LEED Contractor
nodes.rationale: CG's sustainability initiatives + affluent homeowners = demand for green construction. Only 76 construction firms.

nodes.name: Pool / Outdoor Living Specialist
nodes.rationale: FL climate + high-income homes. Pool construction/renovation is a perennial demand.

nodes.name: EV Charging Network / Station
nodes.rationale: Only 5 transportation businesses total. EV adoption growing, CG income demo buys EVs at 2x national rate.

nodes.name: Executive Car Service / Chauffeur
nodes.rationale: MIA airport proximity, Brickell/downtown commuters, 150+ MNCs. Zero car services in database.

nodes.name: Art Gallery / Exhibition Space
nodes.rationale: CG has rich arts heritage (Lowe Art Museum, Art Cinema). Giralda experiential district needs gallery presence.

nodes.name: Music / Performing Arts Academy
nodes.rationale: Education strong (202) but arts education thin. Family-dense corridors = youth arts demand.

nodes.name: Podcast / Content Studio
nodes.rationale: Only 6 media businesses in all of CG. Creator economy booming. Affordable rents on Douglas make this viable.

nodes.name: Local News / Community Digital Media
nodes.rationale: 50K residents with no dedicated local digital media outlet. Community journalism fills civic need.

nodes.name: Wealth Management / Family Office
nodes.rationale: CG's banking corridor (52 banks) but limited wealth mgmt. $134K median income = sophisticated financial needs.

nodes.name: Cryptocurrency / Digital Asset Advisory
nodes.rationale: Miami is a crypto hub. CG's finance cluster + tech-savvy high-income demographic = natural fit.

nodes.name: Sustainability / ESG Consulting
nodes.rationale: CG's green city initiatives + corporate ESG mandates. Only 29 consulting firms total.

nodes.name: International Trade Consulting
nodes.rationale: CG is Latin America gateway. 150+ MNCs but minimal trade consulting. LATAM corridor opportunity.
